description: This file is a shell script ('security_scans.sh') that automates security scanning tasks for the LiteLLM project, including installing tool dependencies, running vulnerability scans with Trivy and Grype, and performing secret detection with ggshield. It contains functions for setup, scanning, and reporting vulnerabilities, aimed at ensuring security for the project.

methods.name: install_trivy
methods.description: Installs the Trivy vulnerability scanner and updates package sources.

methods.name: install_ggshield
methods.description: Installs the ggshield tool for secret detection.

methods.name: run_secret_detection
methods.description: Runs secret detection scans using ggshield, ensures API key is set.

methods.name: run_trivy_scans
methods.description: Performs filesystem vulnerability scans on specified directories with Trivy.

methods.name: run_grype_scans
methods.description: Builds Docker images and scans them for vulnerabilities with Grype, including locally built images.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates tool installation and scans.
